backup.production_rule: One new table (verifier_findings, empty on arrival), three new functions, one partial index on that empty table, and two job_heartbeats rows. No existing column, row, function, policy or grant is changed. Nothing calls any of it until the system-verifier Edge Function is deployed in SPEC-11 session 2, so the applied state is inert. Take a FRESH backup - the one used for meter_followup_resolution_20260921 will be older than the contract's one-hour window.

forward_verification.name: findings_table_exists_with_rls
forward_verification.query: select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.verifier_findings'::regclass

forward_verification.name: all_three_functions_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('run_system_verifier_v1', 'apply_verifier_run_v1', 'telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1')

forward_verification.name: all_three_are_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('run_system_verifier_v1', 'apply_verifier_run_v1', 'telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1') and p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']

forward_verification.name: checks_and_apply_are_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text, jsonb, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text, jsonb, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE')

forward_verification.name: both_heartbeat_rows_seeded
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from public.job_heartbeats where job_name in ('system-verifier-hourly', 'system-verifier-daily')

rollback.safe_until: always while SPEC-11 session 2 is unbuilt, because nothing calls any of this yet. Once the system-verifier function is deployed and scheduled, unschedule its two cron jobs first.

steps.name: unschedule_the_cron_jobs_if_they_exist
steps.action: select cron.unschedule('system-verifier-hourly'); select cron.unschedule('system-verifier-daily'); - only needed once SPEC-11 session 2 has scheduled them

feature_flags.name: system_verifier_is_inert_until_session_2
feature_flags.required_state: This release adds no caller of its own. run_system_verifier_v1 reads and nothing else; apply_verifier_run_v1 and telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1 are service_role only and nothing invokes them. The two auto-resolutions therefore cannot fire until the system-verifier Edge Function exists, is deployed and is scheduled, which is SPEC-11 session 2. Applying this release changes no observable behaviour anywhere.

compatibility.evidence: One new table, three new functions, one index, two seed rows; nothing before this release names any of them. All eight checks (V1-V6, V11, V12) were run read-only against production on 2026-09-21 and returned clean (V1 0, V2 0, V3 0, V4 0, V5 0, V6 0, V11 auto since 2026-09-11, V12 last good sync 40 minutes old). That pass found a real defect before shipping: calendar_sync_log.status is 'ok', not the design's 'success', so V12 would have raised a red alert on a healthy feed the first time it ran. The V1 self-join, the V3 correlated auto_safe subquery and the V5 aggregation were additionally executed as inline read-only SQL against production to prove the jsonb assembly compiles and returns a well-formed array, and V1 was proven positive against a synthetic overlapping pair supplied through a VALUES CTE: exactly one finding, keyed by both ids in sorted order, both guests named, severity red. pgTAP supabase/tests/database/system_verifier_phase1.sql, 30 assertions, every fixture created and rolled back inside the test transaction; CI runs it on push, there being no local Docker. It is the only cover for apply_verifier_run_v1's state machine (announce once, remind after 24h, resolve when gone, never resolve a check the scope did not run) and for both auto-resolutions, so a red database job on this release must be read as the release failing and not as a flaky test.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
CI's database job has not yet run system_verifier_phase1.sql green on this commit
